Privacy Policy for AutoKeep

Last updated: September 29, 2026

AutoKeep ("we", "our", or "us"), developed by Parth Darji, respects your privacy. AutoKeep is designed from the ground up as a 100% offline, privacy-first application.

1. Information We Collect

We do not collect, transmit, sell, or store any personal data on external servers. All vehicle details, VINs, odometer readings, service receipts, and fuel logs entered into AutoKeep are stored exclusively on your device utilizing Apple's SwiftData framework.

2. Camera and Photo Library Access

If you choose to attach service receipts or vehicle photos, AutoKeep accesses your device photo library locally. These images remain solely on your device and are never uploaded to any remote server.

3. Face ID / Biometrics

Biometric authentication is handled strictly by Apple's LocalAuthentication framework and the Secure Enclave. We never have access to your biometric data.

4. Contact

For any inquiries regarding privacy, please contact: parthdarji@example.com
